reply: Dear Tokyo Expat team, My name is Hiroki Kanazawa, and I run Reusmile, a locally established secondhand buyback and household clearance business with a physical shop in Higashikurume, Tokyo. Founded in 2021, we are now in our sixth year of operation, serving central Tokyo and surrounding areas. I came across your work supporting French- and English-speaking newcomers looking for homes in Tokyo. I wanted to introduce a possible resource for clients who need to sell furniture, appliances, or household belongings before moving or leaving Japan.
